from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path


TASK_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE_ROOT = TASK_ROOT / "source"
INPUT_PATH = SOURCE_ROOT / "test-files" / "electronic_structure" / "boltztrap" / "fermi" / "boltztrap_BZ.cube"
REPORT_PATH = TASK_ROOT / "outputs" / "public_reproduction_report.json"


def write_report(payload: dict[str, object], exit_code: int) -> int:
    REPORT_PATH.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    text = json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
    REPORT_PATH.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    print(text, end="")
    return exit_code


def main() -> int:
    try:
        os.environ.setdefault("PYTHONHASHSEED", "0")
        sys.path.insert(0, str(TASK_ROOT))
        sys.path.insert(0, str(SOURCE_ROOT / "src"))

        from workflow import run

        payload = run(INPUT_PATH)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return write_report(
            {
                "schema_version": "1.0",
                "status": "runner_failure",
                "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
                "error": str(exc),
            },
            2,
        )

    return write_report(payload, 0 if payload["status"] == "post_fix_success" else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

        self,
        lattice: ArrayLike | Lattice,
        species: Sequence[CompositionLike],
        coords: Sequence[ArrayLike],

                pymatgen.core.Lattice or

                lattice with lattice vectors [10,0,0], [20,10,0] and [0,0,30].
